Who You Are:

You are a motivated Finance or Accounting professional who is passionate about the financial industry. You excel at being detail-oriented and have experience with annual planning and financial modeling in a fast-moving environment. In this role, you will be a self-starter who is skilled in communicating with cross-functional partners who have different backgrounds, levels, and experiences. A successful candidate will be able to manage complex workflows that involve multiple stakeholders and build strong relationships across teams.

What You'll Do

  • Help build out and maintain data analyses and reporting to project BHG’s growing list of loan portfolios
  • Assist in loan inventory management and short-term cash forecasting
  • Develop, produce, and maintain optimization models that support business needs across the Capital Markets and Finance departments.
  • Analyze complex financial information, identify trends/opportunities, and provide recommendations to leadership/management for decision-making.
  • Support financial team leadership
  • Develop analyses to support strategic initiatives utilizing financial reporting tools including Excel, SQL, or PowerBI
  • Perform detailed variance analysis evaluating results vs. forecasts, explaining variances attributed to key business drivers, and assisting in month-end financial statements analysis.
  • Work with internal teams, provide analytical insights regarding BHG’s loan portfolios to internal teams, including Accounting, Capital Markets, Legal.
  • Execute continuous process improvement and ad hoc analysis for the organization.
  • Ad hoc projects as requested

What You'll Need

  • “This role is not eligible for employer-provided immigration sponsorship. To be considered, applicants must already possess valid U.S. work authorization that will not require sponsorship now or in the future.”
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a quantitative field preferred
  • 2 - 4 years of progressive data analytics or finance experience
  • Strong quantitative skills, knowledge of financial modeling, and a solid background in lending, capital market specifically structured finance or financial services
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel and common database systems is required, while experience with PowerBI, Tableau or other reporting tools is a plus
  • Self-motivated and strong work ethic, with an ability to work independently on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong analytical, problem solving skills
  • Ability to maintain models, identify key financial & non-financial risks, improve processes, and manage data flow
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with individuals
  • Able to learn quickly and adapt to a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment
  • Able to organize, prioritize tasks, and take accountability
  • Having or actively pursuing a professional certification such as a CFA, MBA, or CPA is a plus

Job Title: Financial Analyst
Industry: Finance / Financial Services
Location: Caribbean Region (Fully Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:

The Financial Analyst will play a key role in analyzing financial data, preparing reports, and providing actionable insights to support budgeting, forecasting, and investment decisions. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and has a strong understanding of financial modeling, market trends, and data interpretation within the financial services sector.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct variance analysis to compare actuals with forecasts and budgets and identify key business drivers.
  • Support the budgeting and forecasting process, working closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Monitor financial performance metrics and industry trends to identify areas for improvement or growth.
  • Assist in preparing materials for investors, board meetings, and financial reviews.
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency in all reporting and analytics.
  • Participate in special projects, cost optimization studies, and profitability reviews.

Key Requirements:

  • Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field is preferred.
  • Proven 2-3 years' experience as a Financial Analyst, Investment Analyst, or in a similar role.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with financial modeling tools or BI software (e.g., Power BI) is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and key financial ratios.
  • Familiarity with the finance industry and financial products/services is highly desirable.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

About FinStrat Management

FinStrat Management is a fractional CFO firm built for venture-backed startups. We turn accounting into insight and finance into action: clear, timely, and confident enough to stand behind in any board or investor conversation. FP&A at FSM is not a reporting function. It is a strategic partner to every founder we serve.

About the Role

The Senior Financial Analyst owns the financial model, structured data, and reporting cadence for a portfolio of FSM clients. This role will be heavily involved in FSM’s data and AI transformation project: standardized models connected to a live centralized data layer, AI-driven analysis, dashboarding and reporting, and a clear migration path to AWS QuickSight as our long-term reporting platform. You will use AI to move faster and smarter, while remaining fully accountable for the judgment behind every number and verifying all reporting.

What You Will Do

  • Own the financial model and reporting cadence for a portfolio of clients, covering actuals, budget, and rolling forecast.
  • Build and maintain standardized, live connected Excel models, ensuring FSM best model principles are followed.
  • Direct, review, and take ownership of every model change made, using AI to speed up variance analysis, commentary drafting, and reporting packs while remaining fully accountable for the output.
  • Produce fast turnaround, presentation-ready dashboards for urgent client requests, and support each client’s migration to AWS QuickSight as their permanent BI platform.
  • Deliver actuals versus budget versus forecast reporting with clear, CFO-ready narrative: not just a variance table, but the 'so what' and 'what next' a founder can act on.
  • Partner directly with CFOs, divisional heads, and clients as a trusted advisor, surfacing the questions the business needs to answer before the market forces the issue.
  • Work within FSM’s centralized data infrastructure (Syncari and AWS S3), flagging data quality issues to financial controllers and your pod rather than owning the pipeline directly.
  • Be prepared to continually improve your technical skills to ensure we provide the best service possible for our clients.
  • Manage competing deadlines across multiple clients and industries, with a strong preference for SaaS.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3 to 6 years of professional experience in financial planning and analysis or a related field.
  • Proven experience building financial models from scratch in Microsoft Excel, not just populating templates.
  • Comfort directing AI tools such as Claude as part of a financial modelling and reporting workflow, with a willingness to pursue formal certification.
  • Experience producing client-facing dashboards or reporting packs; exposure to AWS QuickSight or a similar modern BI platform is a strong plus.
  • A track record of managing multiple clients at once, ideally around five at a time, with strong prioritization skills.
  • Solid working knowledge of US GAAP and the core financial statements: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow.
  • Must speak English proficiently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn numbers into a narrative a non-financial founder can act on.
  • Proven ability to work US business hours, with at least six hours of daily overlap.
  • SaaS industry experience strongly preferred.

Benefits and Perks

  • Compensation commensurate with experience
  • Unlimited vacation
  • Ongoing education and training
  • Bonuses

BryceTech is seeking Financial Systems Analysts at varying experience levels to provide financial management, budget analysis, accounting, and financial systems support to the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division (NSWC PHD). Personnel will support financial planning and execution, analyze financial data, maintain accurate accounting records, reconcile transactions, prepare financial reports, and assist Government stakeholders with managing organizational and program resources. Analysts will use Navy financial systems and other enterprise tools to support accurate, timely, and compliant financial operations.

Responsibilities

  • Support financial planning, budget development, execution, monitoring, and reporting for current and future fiscal years

  • Extract, compile, analyze, and reconcile financial data from Government financial systems, databases, and reporting tools

  • Monitor funding allocations, commitments, obligations, expenditures, and available balances to identify discrepancies and execution concerns

  • Assist with developing budget estimates, forecasts, operating budgets, carryover projections, and financial justifications

  • Prepare financial reports, spreadsheets, presentations, executive summaries, variance explanations, and supporting documentation

  • Review financial transactions and funding documentation for accuracy, completeness, appropriate accounting information, and availability of funds

  • Support the creation and maintenance of Network Activities and perform financial transactions within Navy Enterprise Resource Planning (N-ERP)

  • Review travel authorizations, purchase card submissions, funding requests, and other financial packages to validate accounting information and funding availability

  • Research and resolve discrepancies involving labor and non-labor transfers, unmatched disbursements, undistributed labor, and other accounting transactions

  • Support the preparation, review, processing, and closeout of incoming and outgoing funding documents

  • Analyze historical, current, and projected expenditures, commitments, and obligations to support budget development and financial decision-making

  • Develop and maintain financial tools, metrics, reports, dashboards, and data visualizations to communicate funding status and organizational performance

  • Identify financial trends, risks, variances, and opportunities for cost savings or process improvements

  • Apply applicable financial management policies, procedures, regulations, and internal controls to support accurate and compliant financial operations

  • Assist Government personnel and stakeholders with financial systems, reporting tools, financial documentation, and customer inquiries

  • Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation in accordance with established procedures and reporting requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, economics, or a related field; master's degree may be required for senior levels

  • Professional experience requirements will vary by labor category level, as outlined below

  • Experience or demonstrated ability to analyze financial information, prepare reports, and support budget or accounting activities appropriate to the assigned level

  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and written communication skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications

  • Ability to work with financial data, identify discrepancies, and communicate findings to financial and non-financial stakeholders

  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Active Secret security clearance, if required for the position

Experience Levels

  • Financial Systems Analyst I: Bachelor's degree and no prior professional experience required

  • Financial Systems Analyst II: Bachelor's degree and three (3) years of professional experience required

  • Financial Systems Analyst III: Bachelor's degree and five (5) years of professional experience required

  • Financial Systems Analyst IV: Master's degree and at least 10 years of relevant professional experience

Position is contingent upon contract award.

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

BryceTech is a trusted leader in complex technology domains, delivering data-driven solutions in aerospace, biosecurity, and defense. We specialize in systems engineering, advanced analytics, R&D programs, and strategic advisory support. Our clients – including NASA, DoD, HHS, DHS, and other civil and national security agencies – rely on us to drive mission success and accelerate innovation.

BryceTech has been recognized in the Washington Technology Fast 50 ranking of top high-growth small businesses for five consecutive years and received a GovCon Contractor of the Year Award in 2025, underscoring our strong growth, competitive positioning, and excellence in federal contracting. With a proven track record of winning sought-after contracts, scaling high-performance teams, and executing on critical government missions, BryceTech presents a compelling opportunity for strategic partnerships in the GovCon space.

AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details

The Financial Analyst will develop revenue/expense analyses, reports, and financial presentations. They will create and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual reports. They will also maintain that financial information is recorded accurately. The Analyst will have strong technical skills to work independently but also possess the ability to work collaboratively with other Centers of Excellence. Additionally, the Financial Analyst will present findings and recommendations to senior leadership/executive management.

Responsibilities

  • Develop financial models to evaluate existing and future business

  • Participate in month-end financial close and reporting

  • Help develop annual budget and recurring forecast updates

  • Create monthly, quarterly, and annual reports

  • Analyze, track, and report on large data sets

  • Maintain up-to-date and accurate databases by entering, verifying, and backing up data

  • Aid cost analysis processes by established policies and procedures, providing trends and forecasts

  • Present financial models and findings to senior leaders/executive management

  • Monitor and analyze the competitive environment and make comparative analyses, recommended changes in methods and materials

  • Protects ExactCare operations by maintaining confidentiality of financial information

  • Partners cross-functionally across Centers of Excellence to meet financial goals

  • Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.

  • Other duties as assigned.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in finance, economics, or related field.

Experience

  • 2+ years of financial analysis experience

  • Preferred: Healthcare industry knowledge/experience

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong proficiency with Excel and Microsoft Office Suite in general

  • Presenting to senior leaders or executive management teams.

  • Knowledge of finance, financial methods, tools, and strategies

  • Ability to read, interpret, and draw accurate conclusions from numerical material

  • Knowledge of, and ability to use and develop, unique processes, tools, and techniques for exploring alternative financial scenarios and results

  • Knowledge of the functions, automated tools, and processes needed to oversee financial assets and liabilities across the organization

  • Ability to prepare financial statements, reports, and presentations by utilizing financial processes and tools

  • Ability to work independently and bring innovative ideas to the Finance Center of Excellence

May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.

Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

This is a remote position.

The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions.

1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence

  • Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities.
  • Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability.
  • Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios.
  • Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses.
  • Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review.

2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring

  • Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early.

3. Communication & Insight Generation

  • Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee.
  • Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred.

  • Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring.
  • Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes.
  • Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees.
  • Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets.
  • CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred.

As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity.
